label: SurgeSight Experimental Track Forecast
disclaimer: Experimental forecast — not an official meteorological forecast. IMD bulletins remain authoritative.
scientific_notes: Kalman extrapolation is a short-term statistical method; it cannot anticipate recurvature or motion changes that are not already visible in recent fixes.
Environmental wind steering (weighted 850/500/200 hPa annulus-mean GFS winds plus a fixed beta drift) is experimental; weights were set a priori, not tuned.
The steering field is frozen at the cutoff; the model does not use NWP forecast winds.
24-hour positions carry substantially more uncertainty than 6-hour positions.
This model is not a replacement for numerical weather prediction or operational cyclone forecasting. IMD remains authoritative.

wind_source.source: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API — archived NOAA GFS 0.25° (gfs_global) pressure-level u/v winds

method.uncertainty: 90% bivariate-normal ellipse from the propagated position covariance
